headline: 7 more die as measles-related deaths hit 1,019 this year
summary: The DGHS reports 7 new suspected measles deaths in 24 hours, bringing the total number of fatalities to over a thousand in 2024.
details: Seven patients died with measles-like symptoms in the 24 hours leading up to 8:00 am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
These latest fatalities are classified as suspected measles deaths, bringing the total number of suspected deaths this year to 919.
When combined with 100 laboratory-confirmed deaths, the total number of measles-related fatalities in Bangladesh has reached 1,019 this year.
In the same 24-hour window, 816 new suspected cases were reported, pushing the nationwide cumulative total of suspected cases to 170,638.
Additionally, 39 new confirmed measles cases were recorded, bringing the total number of laboratory-confirmed infections to 20,006.
Since March 15, a total of 150,202 patients with suspected measles have been hospitalized across the country.
Of those hospitalized, 144,485 patients have recovered, according to DGHS data.
caption:
Over 1,000 people have died from measles-related causes this year. 7 more died in just the last 24 hours.

Seven patients died with measles-like symptoms in the 24 hours leading up to 8:00 am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).

These latest fatalities are classified as suspected measles deaths, bringing the total number of suspected deaths this year to 919.

When combined with 100 laboratory-confirmed deaths, the total number of measles-related fatalities in Bangladesh has reached 1,019 this year.

In the same 24-hour window, 816 new suspected cases were reported, pushing the nationwide cumulative total of suspected cases to 170,638.

Additionally, 39 new confirmed measles cases were recorded, bringing the total number of laboratory-confirmed infections to 20,006.

Since March 15, a total of 150,202 patients with suspected measles have been hospitalized across the country.

Of those hospitalized, 144,485 patients have recovered, according to DGHS data.

headline_marked: 50,000+ cases: [[Dengue infections surge past 50,000]] in Bangladesh
headline: 50,000+ cases: Dengue infections surge past 50,000 in Bangladesh
summary: Two more deaths reported in Dhaka South City Corporation as the total death toll reaches 143.
details: Over 50,000 people have been infected with dengue in Bangladesh, with 1,056 new cases reported in the last 24 hours.
Two additional deaths were reported in the Dhaka South City Corporation (DSCC) area within the same period.
The total number of deaths from dengue has now risen to 143, while the overall case count stands at 50,276.
Currently, 3,434 dengue patients are receiving treatment in various hospitals across the country.
caption:
Dengue cases in Bangladesh have officially crossed the 50,000 mark. Two more lives were lost in the last 24 hours.

Over 50,000 people have been infected with dengue in Bangladesh, with 1,056 new cases reported in the last 24 hours.

Two additional deaths were reported in the Dhaka South City Corporation (DSCC) area within the same period.

The total number of deaths from dengue has now risen to 143, while the overall case count stands at 50,276.

Currently, 3,434 dengue patients are receiving treatment in various hospitals across the country.
